tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You are a student who recently participated in a group project for your marketing class. One of your group members, Lisa, did an excellent job on her part of the project.
Write an email to Lisa. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Thank her for her excellent contribution to the group project.
Explain what part of Lisa's contribution you appreciated most and how her efforts helped the team succeed.
Suggest working together on future projects and ask for her opinion.
tasks.to: Lisa Subject: Appreciation for group project contribution
tasks.subject: Appreciation for group project contribution
tasks.sample:
Hi Lisa,



I hope you are doing well. I’m writing to sincerely thank you for your excellent work on our recent marketing group project. Your contribution was vital to our team’s success, and I truly appreciate your hard work and dedication throughout the process.



What impressed me most was your market research and data analysis, and your accurate, well-organized work helped us identify target audiences and refine our strategy, which directly led to our good grade. I really enjoyed collaborating with you and wonder if you’d be open to working together on future projects. What are your thoughts about this opinion?



Thank you again for your great effort, and I look forward to hearing from you.



Sincerely,

Alfonso
tasks.title: Write an Email
